description: Exploratory semantic code-search queries about workflow discovery and selection on Kubernaut.
notes: Query text is passed unchanged to each backend.
This suite records search prompts, not gold target paths. Historical expected-file lists were provisional and must not be scored as relevance judgments.
Compare file discovery and relevant-snippet ranking separately; do not compare raw scores from different embedding models.

queries.query: How does workflow selection reject a catalog-valid workflow that was never discovered by list_workflows?
Where is discovered workflow state created, attached to context, and passed to result validation?
How does list_workflows record workflow IDs for later selection validation?

queries.exclusion_reason: The intended target was a *_test.go file, excluded from the matched production-code index scope. Retained here to reproduce the original probe, but do not include it in production-code quality scoring.

queries.query: Only allow the model to select remediation workflows discovered in this investigation context
What happens when the model selects a workflow that exists in the catalog but was not returned by workflow discovery?
How are detected signal labels applied before workflow discovery filters available actions?
How does workflow discovery membership persist across self-correction and retry attempts?
